Author: DriftlessDigits
Name: Balamb Garden
Description: Gardening companion: stand by your garden and water, harvest, or replant a whole patch - or every ripe pot in the house - with one button, at a patient human pace. Keeps a ledger of what's planted where, when you watered it, and when it will be ripe (down to the afternoon). Tips watch your crossbreed pipelines and say when a chain is about to starve. /garden to open.
Changelog: Fixes: no more game crash when the window is open during a teleport loading screen. Walking in the front door no longer sometimes shows every pot as 'reads empty - harvested?' when they're planted just fine (step out and back in if you saw this on the old version). The plugin is also more careful before deciding a pot was harvested behind your back - it double-checks before clearing your watering records.
